data_fields.name: hub_cells
data_fields.donor_constant: 12 hubs, column and row per hub

data_fields.name: sections_per_hub
data_fields.donor_constant: up to 7 section slots per hub

data_fields.name: section_marker_xy
data_fields.donor_constant: x, y pixel marker per section (example 202, 303)

data_fields.name: hub_gate_flag_value
data_fields.donor_constant: world flag must equal 1 to show a hub

data_fields.name: travel_reveal_cycle
data_fields.donor_constant: reveal every third pass of the travel loop (counter set to 2)

best_idea: A walked/seen fog grid where walking reveals a square around the walker, and hubs and their sections appear only after the matching world flags are set.
decision_why: Take the grid reveal and flag-gated hub and section shape, written from scratch (restricted licence, clean-room), with the bounds defect fixed by one COLS/ROWS constant; reject client-side flags as authority because flags must live on the server.
acceptance: Walking a test player across a zone reveals a 3x3 square of fog cells (5x5 with a scout test perk), walked cells stay revealed, a hub label appears only after its first visit, and a server test refuses fast travel to a never-visited hub.
